releases.investigation: BASS and BASS-II plastics and fabrics (PSI-26, PSI-25): kept burning
releases.forecasts: Generic law forward (law.rs) over the declared features. holds_low_flow (binary): rod tip or sphere: flame not quenched by heat loss at the end of the step; holds_high_flow (binary): rod tip or sphere: stagnation flame not blown off; oxygen_limit (positive, 1): rod tip or sphere: oxygen fraction at which the flame goes out at this speed and time; quench_speed (positive, m/s): rod tip or sphere: duct speed below which the flame goes out; blowoff_speed (positive, m/s): rod tip or sphere: duct speed at which the stagnation flame blows off; flat_holds_low_flow (binary): film or slab: flame not quenched; flat_holds_high_flow (binary): film or slab: flame not blown off; flat_quench_speed (positive, m/s): film or slab: duct speed below which the flame goes out
releases.authorship_note: Stage 1 law for whether a sample keeps burning after the igniter; serve it for that question, fabrics included.

inputs.name: x_o2
inputs.note: oxygen mole fraction of the gas entering the duct during the step

inputs.name: flow_speed
inputs.note: duct speed of the step

inputs.name: nose_radius
inputs.note: radius of the rod, sphere or spherical section as installed; 0.01 for a flat sample (weight zero in the flat targets)

inputs.name: heat_time
inputs.note: time from ignition of this burn to the end of the step (for quench and blow-off speeds: to the event); 200 where it is not recorded

inputs.name: is_concurrent
inputs.note: flat samples: 1 if the flame spreads with the flow, 0 against it; 0 for rods and spheres

inputs.name: is_rod
inputs.note: 1 if the sample is a rod (any flow configuration); 0 for spheres, sections and flat samples

inputs.name: flat_thickness
inputs.note: flat samples: thickness as installed; rods, spheres and sections: 0.0005 (weight zero)

inputs.name: u_pot1
inputs.note: the burn's fan curve at fan display 46.5 (pot 1), m/s

inputs.name: is_one_sided
inputs.note: flat samples: 1 if sides_burning is 1, else 0; rods, spheres, sections: 0

inputs.name: is_sibal
inputs.note: 1 if material_class is fabric_sibal, else 0

inputs.name: is_nomex_ultem
inputs.note: 1 if material_class is fabric_nomex (any Nomex) or ultem_sheet, else 0
